response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure development skills with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, aligning well with the technical requirements. However, his experience in production-grade GenAI solutions and cloud-specific AI system design is less explicitly detailed, and his leadership in customer-facing technical discovery sessions is not clearly evidenced.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience with TypeScript and Node.js, relevant to the role's technical stack.
Direct involvement in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, showing familiarity with key technologies.
Proven ability to build and maintain complex systems, including event-driven platforms and high-performance data pipelines.
concerns: Lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, a core requirement for the role.
Limited detail on experience designing AI systems on major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) or working with vector databases/RAG architectures.
Leadership in technical discovery sessions and stakeholder engagement is not clearly demonstrated in the resume.
